## SECTION I General Provisions

## Scope of this Part

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] 45.1. —(1) This Part sets out the amounts to be allowed for costs in the categories of claim to which it applies. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (2) In the categories of claim to which this Part applies, the court has a discretion as to—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (a)whether costs are payable by one party to another;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (b)when they are to be paid; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (c)whether to make an order in the form contemplated by rule 44.2(6)(a). [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (3) Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (a)a claim is one to which Section IV, Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (b)the parties agree or the court orders that a party is entitled to costs,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] subject to rule 44.5 and to the application of any rule in those Sections or this Section by which costs are to be allowed, disallowed, increased or reduced, the court may only award costs in an amount that is neither more nor less than the fixed costs allowed by the applicable Section and set out in the relevant table in Practice Direction 45, unless the paying party and the receiving party have each expressly agreed that this Part should not apply. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (4) Section VI and Section VII of this Part do not apply to a claim or counterclaim which relates, in whole or in part, to a residential property or dwelling and which, in respect of that property, includes a claim or counterclaim for—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (a)possession;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (b)disrepair; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (c)unlawful eviction,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] save where the claim or counterclaim in respect of the residential property or dwelling arises from a boundary dispute. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (5) Where a claim relates in part to a residential property or dwelling and that part of the claim is concluded or discontinued, paragraph (4) shall continue to apply to the remainder of the claim. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (6) Section VI, Section VII and Section VIII of this Part do not apply where a party is a protected party. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (7) In this Part—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (a)‘an order for costs’, includes orders for costs deemed to have been made (either against the claimant or in favour of the claimant) as set out in rule 44.9;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (b)‘the relevant Protocol’ means—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (i)the Pre-Action Protocol for Personal Injury Claims in Road Traffic Accidents (‘the RTA Protocol’); or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (ii)the Pre-action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury Claims (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims (‘the EL/PL Protocol’); and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (c)a reference to a table by number alone is a reference to the corresponding table in Practice Direction 45. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (8) Subject to paragraph (9), a reference in any rule to an amount in a table in Practice Direction 45 is a reference to the amount applicable to a claim on the date that proceedings are issued, regardless of any subsequent amendment. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (9) In respect of any amendment made to Table 12, Table 14 or Table 15 which comes into force on 6th April 2024, the amounts in those Tables as so amended are also applicable to any order for costs made after that date in a claim issued before that date. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Scope of this Part] (10) This Part does not apply to costs incurred in respect of, or in connection with, inquest proceedings. ## VAT

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > VAT] 45.2 . Where appropriate, VAT may be recovered in addition to the amount of fixed in costs rules 45.8 and 45.15A and in Section IV, Section VI, Section VII, Section VIII or Section X of this Part and any reference to fixed costs in those Sections is a reference to those costs net of any such VAT. ## Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)] 45.3. —(1) Where fixed costs are payable under Section IV, Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part and the receiving party—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)] (a)lives, works or carries on business in any area set out in Section II of Practice Direction 45; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)] (b)instructs a legal representative with conduct of the litigation who practises in any of those areas,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)] the fixed costs shall include, in addition to the costs allowable in the relevant Section, an amount equal to 12.5% of those fixed costs (‘London weighting’). [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Additional costs for work in specified areas (‘London weighting’)] (2) In this rule ‘fixed costs’ excludes any disbursements. ## Litigants in person

## 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (a)costs are payable under Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (b)the party in whose favour the costs order is made is at any stage a litigant in person. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (2) Where this rule applies—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (a)rule 46.5 shall apply, save that—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (i)where a party is a litigant in person throughout the entire claim, the costs allowed under this rule shall not exceed, except in the case of a disbursement, two-thirds of the fixed recoverable costs which would have been allowed under Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII if the litigant in person had been represented by a legal representative;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (ii)for any stage in Table 12, Table 14 or Table 15 during which the party is for any period a litigant in person, the costs allowed for that stage shall not exceed two thirds of the costs so specified; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (iii)for any stage in Table 12, Table 14 or Table 15 during which a party is represented by a legal representative for the entire stage, the fixed recoverable costs shall apply as set out in sub-paragraph (b), provided that the total amount of costs to be allowed shall not exceed the costs which would have been allowed if the litigant in person had been represented by a legal representative for the entire claim;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (b)where sub-paragraph (a)(iii) applies, the fixed recoverable costs shall be as follows—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (i)where the stage provides only for a fixed sum, the fixed sum;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.4. —(1) This rule applies to any claim where—] (ii)in any other stage the difference between the fixed recoverable costs for that stage and the fixed recoverable costs for the last stage before that when the party was a litigant in person. ## Entitlement to costs – more than one claimant

## 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (a)fixed costs are payable under Section VI or Section VII of this Part; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (b)orders for costs are made in favour of two or more claimants,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] each claimant is entitled to the costs of their own claim in accordance with the applicable rules in this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (2) Paragraph (1) does not apply where the claim is for a remedy to which the claimants are jointly entitled, and they are joined to the proceedings to comply with rule 19.3. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (3) Paragraph (4) applies where fixed costs are payable under Section VI or Section VII and—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (a)a legal representative with conduct of the litigation acts for more than one claimant in the proceedings;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (b)each of those claimants has a separate claim against the defendant;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (c)an order for costs is made in favour of two or more of those claimants; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (d)the court has ordered that paragraph (4) shall apply. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (4) Where this paragraph applies—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (a)the claimants in whose favour an order for costs is made shall only be entitled to one set of fixed costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (b)the amount of the fixed costs to which those claimants are entitled is the sum of the allowable costs and the further amounts calculated in accordance with paragraph (5) and, where applicable, paragraph (7); and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (c)those claimants are jointly entitled to any costs so ordered. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (5) A further amount equal to 25% of the allowable costs is to be added for each additional claimant in whose favour the order for costs is made. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (6) In paragraph (4), ‘the allowable costs’—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (a)means—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (i)the applicable costs payable to the claimant in respect of whom the damages of highest value are agreed or awarded; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (ii)where paragraph (i) would apply to two or more claimants, the applicable costs payable to whichever one of those claimants their legal representative chooses;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (b)does not include any additional costs under rule 36.24 or increased costs under rule 45.13(2); but

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (c)may include the relevant trial advocacy fees if applicable; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (d)excludes any disbursements. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (7) In addition to the allowable costs under paragraph (4), those claimants who meet the criteria are entitled to London weighting. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.5. —(1)  Unless paragraph (2) or paragraph (4) applies, where—] (8) Where one or more of the claimants referred to in paragraph (4) is entitled either to additional costs under rule 36.24(5) or increased costs under rule 45.13(2), or to both, the percentage increases for which those rules provide must be calculated by applying the relevant percentage to such proportion of the amount referred to in paragraph (4)(b) as reflects the proportion which each claimant so entitled bears to the total number of claimants to which paragraph (4) applies. ## Defendants’ costs

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] 45.6. —(1) Where, in any case to which Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies, the court makes an order for costs in favour of the defendant, the allowable costs are—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (a)the fixed costs set out in Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (b)the applicable disbursements set out in Section IX of this Part. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (2) For the purpose of assessing or determining the costs payable to a defendant by reference to the fixed costs in Table 12 and Table 14—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (a)“value of the claim for damages” and “damages” shall be treated as references to the value of the claim, as defined in paragraph (3); and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (b)if the claim is discontinued, a reference in Table 12 or Table 14 to the stage at which a case is settled shall be treated as a reference to the stage at which the case is discontinued. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (3) For the purposes of paragraph (2)(a), ‘the value of the claim’ is—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (a)the amount specified in the claim form, without taking into account any deduction for contributory negligence, but excluding—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (i)any amount not in dispute;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (ii)interest; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (iii)costs;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (b)if no amount is specified in the claim form, the maximum amount which the claimant reasonably expected to recover according to the statement of value included in the claim form under rule 16.3;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (c)if the claim form states that the claimant cannot reasonably say how much is likely to be recovered—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (i)£25,000 in a claim to which Section VI applies; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (ii)£100,000 in a claim to which Section VII applies;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (d)if the claim has no monetary value—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (i)the applicable amount in rule 45.45(1)(a)(ii) in a claim to which Section VI applies; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (ii)the applicable amount in rule 45.50(2)(b)(ii) in a claim to which Section VII applies; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Defendants’ costs] (e)if a claim includes both a claim for monetary relief and a claim which has no monetary value, the applicable amount in sub-paragraph (d) taken together with the applicable monetary value in sub-paragraph (a), (b) or (c). ## Counterclaims

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] 45.7. —(1) Subject to paragraphs (2) and (3), if in any case to which Section VI or Section VII of this Part applies—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] (a)the defendant brings a counterclaim; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] (b)the court makes an order for costs,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] rules 45.5, 45.6, 45.9, 45.10, 45.11, 45.12, 45.13, 45.43, 45.45, 45.46, 45.49 and 49.50 shall apply as if the counterclaim were a claim. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] (2) No costs are allowable under this rule where the only remedy sought by the counterclaimant is also a defence to the claim. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Counterclaims] (3) Where in a claim to which the RTA Protocol applies, there is a counterclaim which does not include a claim for personal injuries, any order for costs shall be for a sum equivalent to one half of the applicable Type A and Type B costs in Table 10. ## Pre-action and interim applications

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Pre-action and interim applications] 45.8. Where, in any claim to which Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies, the court makes an order for the costs of a pre-action or interim application, the costs which a party may be allowed are those set out in Table 1, together with any appropriate court fee. ## Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs] 45.9. —(1) The court may consider a claim for an amount of costs (excluding disbursements) which is greater than the fixed recoverable costs referred to in Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part where there are exceptional circumstances making it appropriate to do so. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs] (2) If the criteria in paragraph (1) are met, the court may—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs] (a)summarily assess the costs; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs] (b)make an order for the costs to be subject to detailed assessment. ## Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] 45.10 .—(1) The court may consider a claim for an amount of costs (excluding disbursements) which is greater than the fixed recoverable costs referred to in Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (a)a party or witness for the party is vulnerable;

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (b)that vulnerability has required additional work to be undertaken; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (c)by reason of that additional work alone, the claim is for an amount that is at least 20% greater than the amount of fixed recoverable costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (Rule 1.6 and Practice Direction 1A make provision for how the court is to give effect to the overriding objective in relation to vulnerable parties or witnesses). [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (2) If the criteria in paragraph (1) are met, the court may—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (a)summarily assess the costs; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Claims for an amount of costs exceeding fixed recoverable costs – vulnerability] (b)make an order for the costs to be subject to detailed assessment. ## Failure to achieve costs greater than fixed recoverable costs

## 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—] (a)costs are assessed in accordance with rule 45.9(2) or 45.10(2); and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—] (b)the court assesses the costs (excluding any VAT) as being an amount which is in a sum less than 20% greater than the amount of the fixed recoverable costs. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—] (2) The court shall make an order for the party who made the claim to be paid the lesser of—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—] (a)the fixed recoverable costs; and

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > 45.11 .—(1) This rule applies where—] (b)the assessed costs. ## Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] 45.12. —(1) If the criteria in rule 45.9(1) or rule 45.10(1) are not met, the court may make an order for the fixed recoverable costs and any permitted disbursements only. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] (2) Where—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] (a)the court makes an order for costs in accordance with paragraph (1); or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] (b)rule 45.11 applies,

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] the court may decide—

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] (i)to make no order as to the costs of the costs-only proceedings or detailed assessment; or

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Costs of the costs-only proceedings or the detailed assessment] (ii)to make an order for some or all of such costs to be paid by the party making the claim. ## Unreasonable behaviour

[PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Unreasonable behaviour] 45.13. —(1) Where, in a claim to which Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies, an order for costs is made in favour of a party whom the court considers has behaved unreasonably, the other party may apply for an order that those costs be reduced by an amount equivalent to 50% of the fixed recoverable costs which would otherwise be payable. [PART 45 – FIXED COSTS > Unreasonable behaviour] (2) Where, in a claim to which Section VI, Section VII or Section VIII of this Part applies, an order for costs is made against a party whom the court considers has behaved unreasonably, the other party may apply for an order that those costs be increased by an amount equivalent to 50% of the fixed recoverable costs which would otherwise be payable.
